ValidationRule.description: CS approval is blocked unless the two-way price and quantity validation passed or the mismatch review has documented resolution notes.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR(CS_Approved__c = TRUE, ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "CS Approved")), NOT(PO_Validated__c), OR( NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Mismatch Review")), ISBLANK(TEXT(Mismatch_Type__c)), ISBLANK(Mismatch_Notes__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A PO cannot be approved until price and quantity validate, or the mismatch is resolved.
